notePrecision.definition: One-to-one matched notes / all accepted onset notes.

noteRecall.definition: One-to-one matched notes / independently expected onset notes.

octaveFalsePositiveRate.definition: Single-note reference groups with >=1 unmatched accepted +12-semitone onset assigned by the unchanged independent evaluator / all single-note reference groups, including repeats. A group counts once.

trueOctaveExactRecall.definition: Exact reference octave dyads / all reference octave dyads. Exact preserves no-extra and <=100ms chord-spread requirements.

repeatedTargetOnsetRecall.definition: One-to-one matched expected onset notes in repeat-labelled reference groups / all expected onset notes in those groups. Extra notes remain penalized separately.

repeatedStrictGroupRecall.definition: Exact repeat-labelled groups / all repeat-labelled groups. Same repeat selector and exact predicate as the original evaluator.

falseLockEventsPerExpectedGroup.definition: Transitions from non-LOCKED to LOCKED on the correct reference / expected reference groups. Descriptive event density only; not an independent per-trial false-stop probability. Consequential WRONG records while already LOCKED are not additional locks.

unsupported.reason: This baseline exporter has no AMBIGUOUS_OCTAVE or ambiguity-resolution instrumentation and no physical-phone latency observation. UNCERTAIN is not an octave-ambiguity label.

availableAudioContext.limitation: Derived audio-buffer availability, excluding queue/compute/UI/hardware time. Reference times are keyboard actions, not acoustic onset truth. Neither this context nor sample-clock error is measured phone end-to-end latency.

acousticEvaluation.matching: Per-MIDI maximum-cardinality then minimum-error chronological one-to-one matching; no event reuse or time shifting.
acousticEvaluation.eventMeaning: rawOnsetMidi is the production engine accepted onset set after acoustic/temporal confirmation, not raw 88-dimensional NN activations. Practice CORRECT/WRONG/UNCERTAIN decisions never filter these events.
acousticEvaluation.eventCoverage: Current PracticePcmIntegrationTest exports every nonempty frame.onsetMidi via (confirmedInput || onsetMidi.isNotEmpty()). Sparse empty frames are omitted. The evaluator cannot reconstruct raw logits or prove missing-event absence from an older exporter; use the test APK/source identity manifest.
acousticEvaluation.scope: Actual App file replay acoustic gate only. Keyboard timestamps are independently measured action times, not acoustic ground-truth onset or phone microphone latency. Follower correctness/false locks have separate mandatory gates.

reference.sourceKind: website synthesized piano output, not microphone or real piano-room recording
reference.expectedTimelineBasis: independent FFT of the actual BufferSource audio confirms MIDI from fundamental and harmonic lattice; trusted keyboard down/up times relative to sample-contiguous capture; source-spectral-audit.json created before model inference
reference.timingLimit: Keyboard action times are not acoustic onset ground truth. Sample-contiguous AudioWorklet capture; site starts buffered samples at actual AudioContext.currentTime; the website soundfont attack/release remain in the recording. Do not claim hardware microphone latency.

scope: Phase 1 diagnostic baseline. Reproducing a known failure does not satisfy musical acceptance or authorize product release.
